harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured a 3-node MariaDB Galera cluster on node1/node2/node3 (AlmaLinux 9, MariaDB 10.5 + Galera 26.4 from AppStream). Fixed two real issues found during setup: wrong wsrep_provider path (galera-4 vs galera) and a missing RHEL9 SELinux self-connectto rule for mariadb-backup SST (added a minimal local policy module rather than disabling enforcement). Verified multi-master writes (write via any node visible on the other two), verified availability with node3 stopped (2/3 quorum, write succeeded, visible on remaining node), verified automatic IST resync when node3 rejoined (data present, state Synced). Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol for all three nodes: captured baseline boot_id + Synced/cluster_size=3 state, rebooted each node individually (ack returned pre-disconnect via `nohup reboot &`), polled until reachable, confirmed changed boot_id, and confirmed full cluster health/data after each restart before moving to the next node.
actions_performed: Inspected all 3 nodes (AlmaLinux 9.6, no MariaDB pre-installed)
Installed mariadb-server, mariadb-server-galera, mariadb-backup, galera on all nodes via dnf
Opened firewalld ports 3306,4567/tcp+udp,4568,4444 on all nodes
Set up inter-node root SSH using cluster-provided keypair, added /etc/hosts entries from CLUSTER_HOSTS
Generated SST auth password on node1 with openssl and propagated to node2/node3 via scp (never exposed in command text)
Wrote /etc/my.cnf.d/galera.cnf on all 3 nodes (wsrep cluster address, node identity, mariabackup SST)
Diagnosed and fixed wsrep_provider path error (galera-4 -> galera)
Diagnosed SELinux AVC denial (mysqld_t self connectto unix_stream_socket) blocking mariadb-backup SST; built and installed a minimal semodule (galera_sst) on all 3 nodes instead of disabling SELinux
Bootstrapped node1 with galera_new_cluster, created sstuser DB account
Started mariadb on node2 and node3, both joined via SST/IST successfully
Enabled mariadb systemd unit on all nodes for boot persistence
Created galeratest.kv table and network-accessible appuser; verified writes from each node are visible on all other nodes
Stopped node3, wrote via node1, confirmed 2/3 quorum stayed Primary and write replicated to node2
Restarted node3, confirmed automatic IST resync and full data present
Captured pre-restart baseline (boot_id, wsrep_cluster_size, wsrep_local_state_comment) on all 3 nodes
Sequentially rebooted node1, node2, node3 one at a time using backgrounded `reboot` so the ack returned before disconnect
Polled each node until exec was available again and confirmed changed boot_id
Verified post-restart MariaDB active, Galera cluster_size=3/Synced/Primary, and galeratest.kv data intact after each individual node restart

evidence.requirement: 3-node Galera cluster configured and healthy
evidence.summary: All 3 nodes report wsrep_cluster_size=3, wsrep_local_state_comment=Synced, wsrep_cluster_status=Primary

evidence.requirement: Writes through any member are available from the other members
evidence.summary: Inserted one row via each of node1/node2/node3's TCP endpoint using appuser; all 3 nodes' SELECT returns all 3 rows identically

evidence.requirement: Database stays available when one member is unavailable
evidence.summary: Stopped mariadb on node3; node1 showed cluster_size=2/Primary and successfully wrote a new row; node2 immediately read that new row

evidence.requirement: Unavailable member resynchronizes automatically when it returns
evidence.summary: Started mariadb on node3; it auto-rejoined (cluster_size=3, Synced) via IST and its data includes the row written while it was down, with IST log lines showing the transfer completing

evidence.requirement: SELinux root-cause fix for SST failure (supporting evidence for cluster functioning at all)
evidence.summary: AVC denial captured via dmesg (mysqld_t self connectto denied); custom semodule galera_sst built and installed on all 3 nodes instead of weakening SELinux enforcement

evidence.requirement: Node1 restart: healthy baseline
evidence.summary: boot_id=989aa755-... captured with wsrep_cluster_size=3, Synced before restart

evidence.requirement: Node1 restart: acknowledgement + changed boot identity + recovery
evidence.summary: reboot command acked before disconnect; subsequent exec failed (node down) then succeeded with new boot_id=cd058f31-...; post-restart mariadb active, cluster_size=3/Synced/Primary, all 4 rows present

evidence.requirement: Node2 restart: healthy baseline
evidence.summary: boot_id=97c5762b-... captured with wsrep_cluster_size=3, Synced before restart

evidence.requirement: Node2 restart: acknowledgement + changed boot identity + recovery
evidence.summary: reboot acked; node unreachable then returned with new boot_id=2b45f831-...; post-restart mariadb active, cluster_size=3/Synced/Primary, all rows present

evidence.requirement: Node3 restart: healthy baseline
evidence.summary: boot_id=15443601-... captured with wsrep_cluster_size=3, Synced before restart

evidence.requirement: Node3 restart: acknowledgement + changed boot identity + recovery
evidence.summary: reboot acked; node unreachable then returned with new boot_id=2b35cb06-...; post-restart mariadb active, full 3/3 cluster Synced/Primary confirmed from both node3 and node1, all data intact
